answer: An operator holds one numbered dredge lease on a charted lagoon shoal and one slip in the adjoining haven. Only that holder may release the lease's uniquely ringed raven from the slip at a posted slack and haul after the bird returns with a waxed silt vial. Graders match ring, vial grain, slip stamp, and the haven clock. A shared lease, a restuffed vial, or a substitute bird is forfeited as one farm. Fielding N aliases costs N exclusive shoals, N slips, and N live slack-water returns no single courier can cover in the same hour.
